overview: This 225-page file documents U.S. scrutiny of credit and securities transactions involving Japan in 1940. Correspondence on Australian wheat sales, Japanese bonds in the Philippines, American investment in Mitsubishi, and proposed loans accompanies securities law materials and detailed studies of Japan’s wartime budgets, debt, and inflation.
interest: Diplomatic correspondence and statistical studies show how U.S. officials assessed Japan’s war financing and foreign credit.
